home.text: for context reasons, the main session should act like a project director/orchestrator, with threads used to isolate context for a given workflow; so I think we need a relatively dynamic approach; a sub-session, running the skill is opened for deep work that will require/benefit from context window isolation. The director can use agent<>agent messaging to coordinate between the main thread and sub threads. The use should be able to stay in aviator/director/orchestrator session and only click into the sub-thread as needed. Please explore this direction. Main/aviator sessions should feel like a Claude code project, and modes should be powered by threads. We still need to resolve how the aviator thread shows a mode for the high level interactions.
